issue_context.title: HomeKit Bridge: KeyError on `HVACAction.PREHEATING` in Thermostat Accessory
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When using the HomeKit Bridge integration in HomeAssistant, I encountered an error when trying to expose an HVAC device that supports the "preheating" state to HomeKit. The system throws the following error:
```
2024-08-14 16:18:39.485 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.helpers.event] Error while dispatching event for climate.********** to <Job track state_changed event ['climate.**********'] HassJobType.Callback <bound method HomeAccessory.async_update_event_state_callback of <accessory display_name='**********' services=['AccessoryInformation', 'Thermostat']>>>
Traceback (most recent call last):
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/event.py", line 352, in _async_dispatch_entity_id_event
hass.async_run_hass_job(job, event)
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/core.py", line 938, in async_run_hass_job
hassjob.target(*args)
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/homekit/accessories.py", line 514, in async_update_event_state_callback
self.async_update_state_callback(new_state)
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/homekit/accessories.py", line 538, in async_update_state_callback
self.async_update_state(new_state)
File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/homekit/type_thermostats.py", line 627, in async_update_state
homekit_hvac_action = HC_HASS_TO_HOMEKIT_ACTION[hvac_action]
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^
KeyError: <HVACAction.PREHEATING: 'preheating'>
```
It seems that HVACAction.PREHEATING is not correctly mapped to a corresponding HomeKit HVAC action, leading to a KeyError exception.

I would appreciate any guidance or a fix for this issue. Thank you!

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.8.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

HomeKit Bridge

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/homekit
